metaTitle: Custom Kraft Wine Carriers & Totes | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom kraft wine carriers & totes with your logo. Eco-friendly and perfect for promotions. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Kraft wine carriers and totes offer a natural, eco-friendly look that stands out from standard nylon or polyester options. The unbleached brown kraft material provides a rustic, artisanal feel ideal for wineries, tasting rooms, or corporate gifts with a sustainable angle. These carriers hold one or two bottles securely and can be customized with screen printing or foil stamping for a refined logo impression. Perfect for trade shows, client appreciation, or holiday gifting.
